behaviour: 1. VALIDATE: cost 4 elixir [DATA spells_other.Fireball.ManaCost]. Territory Anywhere: enemy side, river, on top of buildings/towers all legal [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball 25/4/2018 river; DATA cr-csv 2023 CanPlaceOnWater/CanDeployOnEnemySide/CanPlaceOnBuildings TRUE]. The 2017-derived spell.can_deploy_on_enemy_side=false and can_place_on_buildings=false are BLANK cells, not facts: do not consume them [INFERENCE]. arena.rs deploy_zone already returns Ok for Territory::Anywhere before the water check.
2. COMMIT: elixir spent and card cycled at the command, as for troops [INFERENCE: engine convention].

3. LAUNCH: in the first Spawn phase after the command (same latency as a troop, so both teams' same-tick casts materialise together) create one spell projectile: team = caster, source entity = caster King Tower [COMMUNITY wiki King's Tower: spell damage 'originates from the King Tower and technically counts as an attack by it'], pos = launch point (calibration spells.LAUNCH_POINT, default caster king tower centre arena.rs::king_tower_pos) [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball: 'travel time ... depending on how far it is sent from the King's Tower'], aim = tap point, fixed [DATA Homing blank], no pre-launch delay [DATA CustomDeployTime blank].

4. FLIGHT: each Projectile phase advance by 600 * projectile.SPEED_TO_SUBTILES_PER_TICK along the straight ground segment with fractional carry (path.rs::advance). Gravity 50 is treated as visual (key projectile.FLIGHT_PATH) [INFERENCE]. Flight is never blocked or deflected in the thin slice [INFERENCE; DeflectBehaviour is Monk-only].

5. IMPACT HIT TEST, evaluated on the arrival tick with positions as they are then, not at cast [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball: troops at the edge at launch 'may not be hit by the time the spell actually lands']: every live entity that is an enemy of the caster [DATA OnlyEnemies], air or ground [DATA AoeToAir, AoeToGround], with centre distance <= 45000 subtiles + victim collision radius (edge-inclusive, as combat.rs::splash does today; key spells.AOE_HIT_TEST) [INFERENCE]. A crown tower is reached by a square instead: the distance from the spell's point to a square of half-side 1000 native round the tower's centre, strictly below the spell's radius (spells.CROWN_TOWER_SPELL_REACH = client_square_1000_strict, measured on client 15.535.29). Skip hidden entities (underground Tesla) once hiding exists [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball: Tesla 'immune to it while underground'; DATA projectiles.csv has no AffectsHidden, AEO AffectsHidden TRUE only on Freeze].

6. DAMAGE into the damage buffer: level-scaled damage (325 at level 1 of the 2017 Rare table) to troops and non-crown buildings (Cannon, Tesla) in full [COMMUNITY wiki 'quite effective versus buildings']. Crown towers (princess and king) take dmg + trunc_toward_zero(dmg * CTDP / 100) = ceil(dmg * pct / 100), with CTDP -60 in the 2017 vintage [DATA; law: COMMUNITY, Supercell published L11 values fit 7/7 non-circular points vs 3 for floor]. A king tower hit triggers activation (already in engine) [COMMUNITY wiki King's Tower].

7. KNOCKBACK SELECTION (buffered like damage, never applied inline): among the step-5 victims, every TROOP (never a building or crown tower: no Speed column) [DATA; INFERENCE] whose ignore_pushback is false, because PushbackAll is false for Fireball [DATA; decoded: only Log/Monk/MegaCannon ship PushbackAll TRUE and the wiki names exactly Log, Monk and Little Prince as pushing 'all ground troops']. Air units are included [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball: Balloon 'knocked away', Inferno Dragon ramp reset]. Thin slice live: pushed = Knight, Archer, Musketeer, HogRider, Minion, BabyDragon, Valkyrie, Skeleton, Wizard; not pushed = Giant, Prince.

8. KNOCKBACK VECTOR: unit(victim.pos - impact point) * Pushback (32400 subtiles for the 2017 vintage, 18000 live) [DATA Pushback = distance; COMMUNITY radial: wiki 'place ... on the side of the troop opposite to where the player would like to redirect it']. Integer normalisation: i64 isqrt, remainder handling ours. Zero vector (victim exactly on the impact point): key knockback.ZERO_VECTOR_DIRECTION, and it must be mirror-symmetric (for example the caster's forward y) [INFERENCE; crforge's fixed (0,+1) for both teams breaks the 180-degree seat symmetry]. Two knockbacks landing on one unit in the same tick are combined by an order-independent rule (key knockback.STACKING, default vector sum) [INFERENCE].

9. KNOCKBACK MOTION: the displacement is spread over knockback.DURATION_MS (0 = instant) [INFERENCE; no data key in 2017 or 2023]. During it the unit neither walks nor attacks, and an attack windup in progress is reset to Idle (not paused like a stun) [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball: 'a true stun that resets the attack animations'; wiki The Log: 'will reset their attack animation']. The target is not force-cleared; ordinary retargeting applies afterwards [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball: Rascal Boy 'possibly causing him to retarget'; VH2018: Sparky no longer resets after being knocked out of range].

10. KNOCKBACK TERRAIN: the river does not block the displacement [COMMUNITY wiki The Log: push 'the unit over the river back to the opponent's side']. A ground unit left on a water cell is resolved by knockback.WATER_RESOLUTION [COMMUNITY VH2020: hover units 'When knocked into the river, they will no longer bounce off of it', which implies ground units do bounce]. Clamp to arena bounds [INFERENCE].

11. RESOLVE/REAP as usual: deaths from the damage buffer; the projectile is removed on its arrival tick. A unit killed this tick is not displaced (displacement is irrelevant once it is dead) [INFERENCE].

shared_mechanics: CAST PIPELINE (all projectile spells: Fireball, Arrows, Rocket, Goblin Barrel's barrel). A deploy command validates with Territory::Anywhere, including river and buildings (live since 2018-04-25). In the next Spawn phase it enqueues SpellProjectile{team, source=caster KingTower id, pos=spells.LAUNCH_POINT, aim=tap point (fixed), speed=raw*projectile.SPEED_TO_SUBTILES_PER_TICK, damage carrier, release_ms}. It advances in the Projectile phase with fractional carry; on arrival it writes damage into the DamageBuffer and knockback into a parallel KnockbackBuffer, and resolves in one pass. Same-tick casts by both teams must be indistinguishable from either order. Sources: wiki Fireball/King's Tower (launch from the King's Tower); spells_other CustomDeployTime blank (no cast delay); engine TICK_PHASES convention.

DAMAGE CARRIER RESOLUTION. If spells_other.CustomFirstProjectile is set, it carries the damage and Projectile is visual (the 2017 Arrows and Princess pattern). Otherwise Projectile carries the damage. MultipleProjectiles is a visual or sub-area count, never a damage multiplier; waves are ProjectileWaves x ProjectileWaveInterval (2023+ columns, defaulting to 1 and 0 when absent). Loader: card.rs RawProjectileObj reads speed, damage and radius, the target buff, homing, the range projectile's range and radius, aoe_to_air, aoe_to_ground, only_enemies, pushback and pushback_all, the pingpong time, check_collisions, the start extra radius, the random delay, a spawned projectile and a spawned area effect. The engine acts on each through its own ledger key. Spells load as card.rs SpellShape.

CROWN TOWER REDUCTION ENCODING AND ROUNDING. CrownTowerDamagePercent raw is a delta from 100 (blank means 100). Cross-vintage evidence: 2017 -60 <-> 40% before 12/12/2017; 2023 -70 <-> 30% (2020-08-04); 2023 Rocket -75 <-> Supercell 371 = 25% of 1484; 2023 Log -80 <-> Supercell 58 = 20% of 290. Rounding: towers take dmg + trunc_toward_zero(dmg*CTDP/100) (== ceil(dmg*(100+CTDP)/100)). It reproduces all 8 Supercell-published level-11 values checked (7/7 non-circular); combat.rs::damage_against's floor reproduces 3/8 and round-half-up 5/8 (checked against the published level-11 values). 'Crown tower' means princess + king only (EntityKind::is_crown_tower); Cannon and Tesla take full damage.

AOE HIT TEST FOR SPELLS. Evaluated on the arrival tick; OnlyEnemies; AoeToAir/AoeToGround choose the flying/ground sets with height ignored; edge-inclusive (centre distance <= radius + victim collision radius) is the engine convention and is UNVERIFIED for spells. A crown tower is reached by the square of spells.CROWN_TOWER_SPELL_REACH instead (half-side 1000 round its centre, strictly below the radius; measured). Hidden entities (underground Tesla) are immune to projectile spells (no AffectsHidden column on projectiles.csv).

KNOCKBACK LAW (Fireball, Rocket, The Log, Bowler, Mega Knight spawn, Golem/Golemite death). Data semantics settled by cross-card and history checks. Pushback is a displacement DISTANCE in millitiles (Fireball 1800 <-> Supercell '1.8 tile'; Log 1000 <-> wiki '1 tile' 23/1/2017; Golemite 1800 -> wiki '0.9 (from 1.8)'). PushbackAll=TRUE overrides the victim's IgnorePushback: only Log, Monk and MegaCannon ship it (2023), and the wiki names exactly Log, Monk and Little Prince as pushing 'all ground troops'; the Log reset Prince/Dark Prince charge from 19/9/2016. PushbackAll=false does NOT mean primary-target-only (Fireball, Bowler and Mega Knight spawn all push many). There is no mass term in any column (Mass is collision-only; Tornado's push_mass_factor is a buff column). Direction is radial from the impact for area sources and along travel for rolling or piercing ones (COMMUNITY). Buildings and crown towers are never moved. Air units are pushed. A windup in progress is reset, not paused (COMMUNITY). The river does not block the push and ground units in water get resolved (COMMUNITY). Duration, zero-vector direction, stacking, water resolution, displacement falloff and deploy-state behaviour are NOT in any data (no globals key in 2017 or 2023) and must be calibration keys. Buffer the displacements and combine them commutatively; the zero-vector fallback must be mirror-symmetric (crforge's fixed (0,+1) is not).

behaviour: 1. DEPLOY: legal anywhere in the arena including the enemy side and the river, costs 2 elixir, no deploy timer. deploy() appends an AreaEffect record {team, pos, level, def=area_effect_objects.Zap, life_ms=1, pulse_acc_ms=0, applied=false}; no entity is spawned. Grid snapping and elixir/hand checks belong to the deploy code, not this family. [DATA spells_other.Zap CustomDeployTime blank; COMMUNITY wiki Zap 'deploys instantly', 2018-04-25 'allowed the Zap to be placed on the river']

2. PHASE: the record is processed in the first tick N after the cast, in a new Phase::AreaEffect placed after Projectile and before Resolve. Reason: every writer of the damage buffer must come before Resolve (lib.rs), and pulses should see post-move positions, like projectile arrivals. TICK_PHASES and its phase-order test change in the same commit. [INFERENCE: placement is ours; a one-tick shift is unobservable]

3. ONE-SHOT APPLICATION: HitSpeed is blank, so the AEO applies exactly once, on its first update, whatever LifeDuration says (LifeDuration=1 ms is shorter than a tick). Then life_ms -= TICK_MS. At <=0 the record is removed at the end of the phase. It never touches a unit that enters the radius later. [DATA LifeDuration=1, HitSpeed blank; COMMUNITY crforge OneShotHandler does the same]

4. VICTIM SET: every alive entity with hp>0 whose team != record.team (OnlyEnemies; no friendly fire) that passes (flying ? HitsAir : HitsGround) (both TRUE) and is not hidden (AffectsHidden blank). Troops, buildings (IgnoreBuildings blank) and both crown towers (NoEffectToCrownTowers blank) all qualify. Deploying troops (deploy_ms>0) qualify. Geometry: fixed::in_range_edge(record.pos, victim.pos, milli(2500), victim.radius), i.e. the edge-to-edge reading the engine's splash already uses (UNSETTLED, see unsettled[0]); a crown tower by the square of spells.CROWN_TOWER_SPELL_REACH instead (measured). Candidates come from SpatialHash::neighbours_within(pos, milli(2500)+max_radius), which is index-sorted. There is no target cap, so no tie-break and no mirror asymmetry. [DATA OnlyEnemies/HitsAir/HitsGround/AffectsHidden; COMMUNITY wiki Zap kills a Skeleton Army or Bats as they deploy; hidden Tesla per supercell.com 2026-06-01]

5. DAMAGE: amount = CardDb::scale(75, Common multiplier[level]), which is 159 at the engine default level 9. Each victim gets Hit{target, damage_against(kind, amount, crown_pct)} pushed into the DamageBuffer. crown_pct is 40 in the 2018 data (live: 25). The damage is summed and applied in Resolve with everything else, so a unit whose windup completes in tick N's Attack phase still lands that hit, and a unit Zap kills in tick N still swings in tick N. [DATA; simultaneous outcomes may not depend on entity order]

6. BUFF: every victim also gets BuffApply{target, name=ZapFreeze, class=STUN (all three raw multipliers == -100), duration_ms=500, source=Aeo} pushed into a new BuffBuffer. [DATA area_effect_objects.Zap.Buff/BuffTime, character_buffs.ZapFreeze]

7. RESOLVE (tick N), in this order. (a) Apply the damage buffer as today: sums, shields, deaths, king_hit. Zap damage on an inactive King Tower starts its activation. (b) Decrement existing stun timers by TICK_MS. This moves from phase_status to here so a D-ms buff suppresses exactly ceil(D/TICK_MS) ticks. (c) Apply the BuffBuffer to targets still alive after (a): stun_ms = max(stun_ms, 500). Merging is max plus OR, so buffer order is irrelevant. [DATA; COMMUNITY wiki Freeze 'may damage and activate it' (King); alignment is ours]

8. ON STUN APPLICATION (each application, including a refresh). Set target_locked=false and retarget_on_resume=true (new per-entity bool, hashed and serialized). Reset charge state (Prince; implemented in state.rs::charge_pass, gated by tests/charge.rs) unless the source is the Clone buff and CLONE_RESET_CHARGE=FALSE. Reset the variable-damage ramp to stage 1 (Inferno; not in the thin slice). If load_first_hit && LOGIC_LOAD_FIRST_HIT_RESET_TIMER_WHEN_ZAPPED, set attack_phase=Idle and attack_ms=0 (Sparky; not in the thin slice). Leave attack_phase and attack_ms UNCHANGED for every other attacker. [COMMUNITY supercell.com 2017-03-13, verified at source: 'All stun/freeze effects will now pause the target's attack, causing them to retarget when they resume. Exceptions are Sparky, Inferno Tower and Inferno Dragon, which will still be reset'; same post 'Clone: No longer resets charging troops (Princes, Sparky, etc.)'; wiki Zap 'reset charging attacks from ... Prince'; DATA globals.csv LOGIC_LOAD_FIRST_HIT_RESET_TIMER_WHEN_ZAPPED=TRUE, CLONE_RESET_CHARGE=FALSE, CLONE_RESET_TARGET=FALSE]

9. WHILE STUNNED (ticks N+1..N+10). Target phase: the stun's landing clears the target and releases the lock (status.STUN_CLEARS_TARGET = client_cleared, measured on client 15.535.29); no scan while held. Path phase: no movement proposal (already). Move phase: the unit can still be displaced by collision separation and knockback. Attack phase: attack_step(can_act=false) freezes phase and ms (already). REQUIRED FIX: phase_attack currently sets target_locked = preserve && phase==Windup every tick, which re-locks a stunned unit in Windup; gate it on stun_ms==0. Also frozen: spawner timers and the Tesla hide/emerge timers (a stunned Tesla cannot retreat). Still running: deploy_ms, building lifetime_ms, king_wake_ms, the buff timers themselves. A projectile the unit has already launched keeps flying. [DATA HitSpeed/Speed/SpawnSpeed -100; COMMUNITY wiki Freeze 'Troops frozen by the Freeze will remain frozen even if they are pushed out of the Freeze's radius'; wiki Freeze 'will not affect the King Tower's activation animation'; wiki Rage 'building lifetime still drops with its normal rate, even with the Rage'; wiki Tesla 'The retreat can also be stopped with a Freeze spell'; INFERENCE for deploy_ms and in-flight projectiles]

10. RESUME (tick N+11, the first tick whose Target phase sees stun_ms==0 and retarget_on_resume). The Target phase bypasses target lock and keep-target hysteresis (LOGIC_RANGE_EXTENSION_TO_KEEP_TARGET) and runs target::scan() as for a fresh unit, then clears the flag. If scan returns the previous target, windup or cooldown resumes exactly where it paused, and phase_attack re-locks it. If it returns a different target, the paused windup carries onto it (status.RESUME_RETARGET_WINDUP = carry, measured on client 15.535.29; cancel, to Idle, is the old arm). Buildings and crown towers retarget too. [COMMUNITY supercell.com 2017-03-13 'causing them to retarget when they resume'; wiki Zap 'Zapping units or the opposing Crown Tower can possibly change their targets' (X-Bow example); wiki Rage 'unlike the Zap, it does not force the Crown Tower to retarget']

11. OVERLAP: a second stun (another Zap, an E-Wiz hit, Freeze, Lightning) sets stun_ms = max(remaining, new) and never shortens a longer one. Step 8's resets fire again at each application. Retarget happens once, when the last stun ends. [INFERENCE: ZapFreeze has no EnableStacking and different buff names coexist in Supercell's buff model; COMMUNITY supercell.com 2017-03-13 'Electro Wizard: No longer permanently stuns' is consistent with pause+refresh; crforge AppliedEffect.refresh uses max]

12. TESLA: a revealed Tesla is damaged and stunned and cannot retreat while stunned. A hidden Tesla is excluded from the victim set. Hide is implemented: entity.rs::HideState and state.rs::hide_pass read hides_when_not_attacking / hide_time_ms / up_time_ms, target.rs and combat.rs::resolve honour it, and tests/hide.rs gates it. [DATA buildings.csv Tesla HidesWhenNotAttacking=true, HideTimeMs=800, UpTimeMs=800; COMMUNITY wiki Tesla; supercell.com 2026-06-01]

13. PRINCE: stun resets his charge; after the stun he must build the charge up again from zero. Charge is ABSENT, so step 8 is a call-out the charge implementation must make. Knockback (Log) resets charge through the same call-out (other family). [COMMUNITY wiki Zap, wiki Freeze, supercell.com 2017-03-13 Clone note; wiki Sparky 'The knockback from The Log will also reset the charge of the Prince']

14. DETERMINISM: the AreaEffect list and retarget_on_resume go into state_hash and the save/load snapshot, alongside projectiles. Zap has no randomness and no capped target selection. Its mirror is a Red Zap at (x, 32-y). , under the 180-degree seat symmetry.
cards.targets_affected: Enemies only (OnlyEnemies): own troops, buildings and towers are never damaged or stunned (no friendly fire). Ground and air troops (HitsGround, HitsAir). Enemy buildings (IgnoreBuildings blank): Cannon always; Tesla only while not hidden (AffectsHidden blank; hidden Tesla is immune to both damage and stun). Enemy crown towers, Princess and King (NoEffectToCrownTowers blank): damaged at CrownTowerDamagePercent (2018 raw -60 = 40%; live 25% since 2026-06-01, L11 48) and stunned (their attack pauses and they retarget on resume). Damage on an inactive King activates it; the stun does not delay that activation. Deploying troops are hit. No knockback, no target cap, no level-scaled stun duration.
unsettled: AEO radius geometry. (E) victim hit if dist(centre, victim) <= 2500 milli + victim CollisionRadius, the engine's splash convention and ADD_CHARACTER_RANGE_TO_RADIUS by analogy. (C) centre-to-centre, dist <= 2500 milli. Nothing public states which, and the Zap / AesDragon hidden-stats wiki pages are silent. Deciding observation: cast Zap with its centre 2.6-3.0 tiles from a stationary enemy Cannon (radius 0.6); under E the Cannon loses HP and flashes stunned, under C it is untouched. A tile-snapped building keeps the geometry exact, and the 0.5-0.6 tile margin is well above video error.

Windup on retarget-to-a-different-target at resume. SETTLED: P2, carry (status.RESUME_RETARGET_WINDUP, measured on client 15.535.29). (P1) the paused windup is cancelled to Idle and a full LoadTime is paid on the new target; this is the engine's existing 'changed && Windup -> Idle' rule. (P2) the paused progress carries over. Deciding observation: a Musketeer locked mid-windup on a far Giant, a Skeleton dropped nearer, then Zap. Measure new-target hit time minus stun end: ~remaining windup under P2, a full LoadTime under P1.

Pause vs reset in the LIVE 2026 game. The 2017-03-13 official note (pause) predates the 2018 data, and the live wiki Freeze and E-Wiz pages still say pause; no later reversal was found. crforge implements reset, the pre-2017 model. Deciding observation (O1): a Knight or Giant attacking a building, Zapped at a known offset t after a hit lands. Pause gives a hit-to-hit interval of HitSpeed+500 ms for every t. Reset gives t+500+LoadTime: shorter than pause when zapped early in cooldown, longer when zapped late in windup. That is categorical at 60 fps.

Tick alignment of buff expiry. (a) ceil(D/TICK_MS) ticks from the tick after application: 10 for Zap, the recommended default. (b) one tick fewer: 9, what the shipped phase_status decrement would produce. There is no deciding observation at video resolution (50 ms vs 16.7 ms, under client interpolation), so this is ours and pinned by a test. NOTE: the calibration.json TICK_MS promotion rule suggests timing 'Zap stun start to end' to settle the tick rate. A 500 ms buff lasts 500 ms under every tick hypothesis, so that measurement is far weaker than it reads.

Crown-tower damage rounding for Zap (feeds combat.DAMAGE_ARITHMETIC). Truncation is contradicted: the official L11 value was 58 at 30% and 192*30/100 = 57.6. Round-half-up and ceil both fit (Fireball's official 207 at 30% of wiki 688 = 206.4 fits ceil only, but 688 itself may be a rounded display). Assumes the published number equals battle damage. Deciding observation (O4): Zap a crown tower at card level 8 (144.75*25% = 36.19: trunc/round 36, ceil 37) and at level 12 (210.75*25% = 52.69: trunc 52, round/ceil 53), reading the tower's displayed HP number before and after.

Which crown-tower percent the engine should ship: 40 (2018 data) or 25 (live since 2026-06-01). The target is the live game, but the stat is card data, not a calibration constant. That is a data-vintage decision, not a mechanic. The same applies to live levels 14-16, which rarities.csv lacks (Common ships an unused_tail 339).

Does a stun applied during deploy pause deploy_ms? (D1) no, both timers run and only stun left after deploy blocks action. This is the recommended default, by analogy with the Freeze wiki's King activation note. (D2) yes. Deciding observation (O6): Zap a Knight about 0.8 s into its 1 s deploy. D1: starts walking about 1.3 s after placement. D2: about 1.5 s.

Is a Tesla hittable during its retreat and emerge animations, or only when fully up? The wiki says 'the retreat is not instant, enabling quick troops ... to get a hit off before it goes underground', which suggests the transition counts as not hidden. It belongs with the hide mechanic itself, but is_hidden() must be defined before Zap can be gated on it.

Semantics of BuffNumber, blank on Zap and 1 on Rage/Freeze/Poison/Heal. Candidates: max stacks per target from one AEO; applications per target; unused. Irrelevant to a one-shot Zap. It matters for pulsing AEOs, where a Poison with EnableStacking re-applied every 250 ms would otherwise hold 4 stacks and deal 4x its DPS.

One-shot AEOs with LifeDuration longer than a tick (Freeze 4000 ms, not in thin slice). (O1) apply once at the first update. (O2) apply to each new entity entering during life. Weak support for O2: wiki Freeze says death-spawned units 'remain frozen until the duration of the Freeze ends', though buff inheritance by death spawns explains that equally. Zap is insensitive: LifeDuration=1 makes O1 and O2 identical. Deciding observation (O7): walk or deploy an enemy troop into an active Freeze 1 s after cast.
ImmuneToAntiMagic=TRUE on ZapFreeze/Freeze/Poison/Stun. No 2018 row sets NegatesBuffs or applies an anti-magic buff, so there is no consumer and no observable. Record it, do not implement it.
EXTRA_BUFF_RADIUS=2000 (globals.csv). No 2018 character uses AreaBuff, so the meaning is unknown: extra radius for AreaBuff auras, or a buff-linger margin around AEOs. No consumer for Zap.

Whether stunned units still push and get pushed in collision separation. The recommended default is yes: the Freeze wiki's 'pushed out of the Freeze's radius' implies displacement while frozen. Who does the pushing is not stated. Deciding observation: a stunned Knight in the path of a friendly Giant walking into it.

shared_mechanics: BUFF MULTIPLIER ENCODING [DATA cross-row + COMMUNITY]. character_buffs Speed/HitSpeed/SpawnSpeedMultiplier: pct(raw) = 100 if blank/0, raw if raw>0 (absolute percent), 100+raw if raw<0 (delta), clamped at 0. Evidence: Rage +135 = +35% (wiki Rage 2016-11-01..2025-10-06); IceWizardSlowDown -35 = -35% (2018); ChargeSpeedMultiplier 200 = 2x; newer crforge data keeps the pattern (Rage 130, IceWizard -30, ArcherQueenRapid 280). No shipped positive value below 100 exists, so the reading of e.g. 50 is untested. Implement as integer percent. Movement uses speed*pct/100 with the existing move_frac carry. Attack and spawn timers advance by TICK_MS*pct/100 per tick with a remainder carry kept in state (not needed while only -100 buffs exist in the thin slice).

HIT-SPEED MULTIPLIER IS A TIMER RATE [INFERENCE, strong]. Attack windup and cooldown timers advance at pct% of real time; the reading 'the period is scaled' is rejected. The -100 limit of the rate reading is exactly the official 2017 behaviour ('pause the target's attack'). The period reading has no sensible -100 limit. Rage +35% therefore makes a 1.5 s attack take 1.111 s, not 0.975 s. The wiki Rage line 'an X-Bow can shoot 4 projectiles every second' weakly favours the rate reading.

STUN CLASS [DATA + COMMUNITY]. A buff is STUN-class iff its speed, hit-speed and spawn-speed raw multipliers are all -100: ZapFreeze, Freeze, Stun and Clone in 2018 data. Freeze and ZapFreeze behave identically (official 2017 note says 'stun/freeze effects'). Sources: AEO Buff (Zap, Freeze, E-Wiz spawn Zap), projectile TargetBuff (LighningSpell ZapFreeze 500, IceSpiritsProjectile Freeze 1500 applied to every entity its AoE damages), character BuffOnDamage (ElectroWizard ZapFreeze 500 per damaging hit). The existing single stun_ms timer is sufficient for the whole class: stun_ms = max over every active STUN-class buff.

STUN EFFECTS [COMMUNITY supercell.com 2017-03-13, verified at source]. On application: the target lock is cleared; retarget_on_resume is set; charge is reset (skipped for Clone while CLONE_RESET_CHARGE=FALSE); the variable-damage ramp is reset; LoadFirstHit attack timers are reset when LOGIC_LOAD_FIRST_HIT_RESET_TIMER_WHEN_ZAPPED=TRUE. Ordinary windup and cooldown are PAUSED, not reset. While stunned: no movement proposal, no target change, frozen attack/spawn/hide timers. Still running: deploy, building lifetime, king activation and buff timers. At resume the unit does a fresh scan() that ignores lock and hysteresis. Clone also skips the target reset while CLONE_RESET_TARGET=FALSE.

ONE INTERRUPT ROUTINE, SEVERAL CAUSES. Implement interrupt(i, cause) once. cause=StunApplied does the step-8 resets above. cause=Knockback (other family) resets the attack windup outright: COMMUNITY wiki Freeze 'It is not like The Log's effect, where the attack animation of affected units will be completely restarted'. It also resets charge (wiki Sparky: Log knockback resets Prince charge). Clone-sourced stuns take the CLONE_RESET_* opt-outs. Charge (Prince) is implemented (state.rs::charge_pass, tests/charge.rs) and the routine must reset it; the Inferno ramp (combat.VARIABLE_DAMAGE) restarts on a stun too, in the same routine.

BUFF BUFFER AND MERGE [INFERENCE; simultaneous outcomes may not depend on entity order]. No writer sets a timer inline. AEO pulses, projectile arrivals and on-damage handlers push BuffApply{target, name, class, duration_ms, source_kind, source_id}. Resolve applies them after damage, skipping targets that died. Merge for a non-stacking name: duration = max(existing, all new). Reset flags are OR-ed. Commutative, so slot and writer order cannot matter. EnableStacking=TRUE (Poison, Heal, Tornado) means one instance per source object (per AEO id) coexisting with others, refreshed by that same source. Re-application every pulse cannot add stacks, or Poison's 250 ms pulses with a 1000 ms buff would triple its damage.

BUFF TICK ALIGNMENT (ours). A buff of D ms applied during tick N is active for ticks N+1..N+ceil(D/TICK_MS). Implement by decrementing buff timers in Resolve immediately BEFORE applying that tick's new buffs, not at Status start (which yields one tick fewer), and update lib.rs Phase::Status docs. Tick N itself can never be suppressed because Attack runs before Resolve.

AREA EFFECT OBJECT LIFECYCLE [DATA columns; INFERENCE timing]. A record {team, pos, level, def, life_ms, pulse_acc_ms, applied, source_id} lives in state beside projectiles, is hashed and snapshotted, and runs in a new Phase::AreaEffect after Projectile and before Resolve. One-shot (HitSpeed blank/0): apply on the first update regardless of LifeDuration (Zap 1 ms). Pulsing: pulse_acc += TICK_MS; while pulse_acc >= HitSpeed {pulse; pulse_acc -= HitSpeed}. The first pulse is therefore at t = HitSpeed, not t = 0: Lightning 1500/460 gives the known 3 bolts; t=0 would give 4. life_ms -= TICK_MS after processing, remove at <=0. Level-scaled life: LifeDuration + LifeDurationIncreasePerLevel*(level steps) (Rage, Freeze; semantics of the step base unverified).

AEO VICTIM FILTER [DATA]. alive && hp>0. Team: OnlyEnemies => enemy of record.team; OnlyOwnTroops => same team. flying ? HitsAir : HitsGround. IgnoreBuildings => skip non-troops (whether this covers crown towers is unverified). NoEffectToCrownTowers => skip crown towers. AffectsHidden false => skip hidden entities (Tesla underground), for both damage and buff. MaximumTargets caps the set, and HitBiggestTargets picks by hp; any cap needs the engine's mirror-invariant tie-break key, never EntityId. Geometry uses in_range_edge with the victim's radius by default (UNSETTLED); a crown tower is reached by the square of spells.CROWN_TOWER_SPELL_REACH instead (measured). Candidates come from the index-sorted spatial-hash query.

AEO DAMAGE AND BUFF AMOUNTS [DATA]. damage = CardDb::scale(Damage, rarity multiplier at the card level; for character-spawned AEOs, SpawnAreaObjectLevelIndex). Per victim use damage_against(kind, damage, crown_pct) with crown_pct = 100 + raw when raw < 0 (cards.json convention; Zap -60 = 40% matches the wiki's pre-2017-12-12 Zap value). buff_time = BuffTime (+ BuffTimeIncreasePerLevel). With CapBuffTimeToAreaEffectTime, buff_time = min(buff_time, the area's life left after the application's tick plus one HitSpeed of the area) (status.AREA_BUFF_SOURCE_BINDING; measured on the Earthquake, client 15.535.29, and the Rage, client 16.402). So the Rage's last application, with 250 ms left after its tick, lasts 550 ms and the buff outlives the area by 250 ms, where wiki Rage says it 'will always expire once the spell's duration ends'. ControlsBuff (Tornado) removes its buff from every entity when the record dies. Damage-over-time buffs deal DamagePerSecond*HitFrequency/1000 per HitFrequency with their own crown percent (not in thin slice; first-tick timing unverified).

MULTI-BUFF COMPOSITION (not needed for the thin slice) [COMMUNITY, conflicting]. Candidates for combining non-stun speed buffs: (M1) multiplicative product (crforge's choice, no source); (M2) additive sum of deltas (fits wiki 'Rage can be used to neutralize the Ice Wizard's slow effect'); (M3) strongest slow wins among slows, combined with the strongest boost (fits wiki Ice Wizard 'does not stack with ... Giant Snowball and Ice Golem' and 'overwritten by the Earthquake and Ram Rider ... more severe'). STUN-class buffs yield zero action under all three, so Zap is insensitive. This is implemented: status.rs carries a per-entity buff list with each buff's raws, and movement.BUFF_SPEED_COMPOSITION = strongest_up_and_down is the arm it runs (M3).

ENGINE CONSUMER GAPS STILL OPEN. (1) phase_attack re-sets target_locked for stunned units in Windup every tick. (2) tools/extract_cards.py still drops BuffNumber, Life/BuffTimeIncreasePerLevel, HitBiggestTargets, ControlsBuff (AEO) and IgnorePushBack (buff), so card.rs cannot honour them from cards.json. AffectsHidden, CapBuffTimeToAreaEffectTime and EnableStacking are emitted now; the buff list of status.rs replaced the dead slow timer, and Tesla hide is implemented (state.rs::hide_pass, tests/hide.rs).

PROJECTILE SPEED UNITS (overlaps the projectile family) [COMMUNITY, weak]. The wiki user blog 'AesDragon/Hidden card stats: Projectile travel speeds' states projectile Speed uses 'the same kind of measurement as troops do' (tiles per minute) and tabulates values equal to projectiles.csv Speed (Fireball 600, Arrows 1100, Log 200, Lightning 500). No source was found for a separate /60-vs-/50 divisor for projectiles; this is an assertion, not a measurement. The engine already uses one SPEED_TO_SUBTILES_PER_TICK for both, flagged UNVERIFIED in card.rs.

VINTAGE CAUTION ON crforge [COMMUNITY]. crforge resets attack state on stun/freeze (resetAttackState: windup, cooldown, accumulatedLoadTime, targetLocked). That is the pre-2017-03-13 model Supercell replaced with pause+retarget. Its buffs.json and cards.json are newer than the 2018 data (Zap crown -70 = 30%, Rage 130, IceWizard -30, Poison speed -15) but predate 2026-06-01, and their provenance is undocumented.

ROLLING (PIERCING) PROJECTILE LAW. Straight along team-forward, speed Speed*k, total travel ProjectileRange from roll start, swept axis-aligned rectangle (half-width ProjectileRadius, half-depth ProjectileRadiusY) tested against victim circles edge-to-edge (shape key). Enemy-only per OnlyEnemies, air/ground per AoeToAir/AoeToGround, a per-projectile hit set so each entity is hit at most once, crown pct through damage_against, level scaling of the caster card. The rectangle-circle test is new integer geometry and belongs in fixed.rs. The same law serves the Bowler and Barbarian Barrel later (BowlerProjectile ProjectileRadius 1000, ProjectileRange 6000).

SpellAsDeploy AIRBORNE PHASE. A first projectile (LogProjectile: Speed 360, MinDistance 3000, Gravity 30, no Damage) with no hitbox whose arrival spawns SpawnProjectile at its landing point, inheriting team, card level and forward direction. Launch geometry is the open key spells.SPELL_AS_DEPLOY_LAUNCH_MODEL.

KNOCKBACK LAW (shared with Fireball and any Pushback source). Distance = Pushback millitiles x18 subtiles [COMMUNITY history: Log 1 tile <-> 1000]. Applied only to troops (not buildings or towers). Skipped for IgnorePushback units UNLESS the source has PushbackAll=true [DATA + COMMUNITY]. Recorded in a buffer during the phase that produced the hit and applied after Resolve to survivors as summed displacements, so the order cannot matter and tie-breaks stay mirror-invariant. Resets the victim's attack windup [COMMUNITY]. Not blocked by water the way walking is [COMMUNITY river lore]. Units mid-jump are immune. Direction (radial from the source centre is the default for both circular and rolling sources), time profile, mass dependence and water/building resolution are all calibration keys with no primary source. The engine does not load ignore_pushback today (card.rs has no field); cards.json already carries it.

SPAWN-ON-ARRIVAL. A projectile with SpawnCharacter enqueues SpawnCharacterCount units of that character on the deferred spawn queue at its arrival point. Level = caster's unified level (SpawnCharacterLevelIndex equals the caster rarity RelativeLevel in every shipped row). deploy_ms = SpawnCharacterDeployTime when present, else the character's DeployTime. Formation is a key. Water fallback is the existing formation rule. card.rs must load cards.json units[] (Goblin) because no card in the thin slice summons a plain Goblin; the same loader serves death spawns later.

VALID SPELL VICTIMS. Deploying units are hittable and pushable (combat::splash already does not skip deploy_ms > 0; keep that for rolling hits). Untargetable states exclude victims: hidden Tesla (live: immune to all damage except Earthquake/Freeze), units mid-jump, and the Skeleton Barrel's 0.5 s release animation (not in slice). Friendly units never, for OnlyEnemies=true sources.

CROWN TOWER DAMAGE PERCENT = 100 + raw column, applied to King and Princess towers with truncating integer division (combat::damage_against). The Log's -60 <-> the wiki's 40% before 2017-12-12 is independent corroboration of the delta-from-100 hypothesis in cards.json conventions.

DATA VINTAGE FINDING (not a mechanic). This family's numbers (Log crown 40%, roll 11.1, Goblin damage 50, barrel deploy 1.2 s) plus the roster (Flying Machine released 2017-10-06, no Royal Ghost) date csv_logic to about 2017-10-06..2017-12-12, earlier than cards.json provenance 'first half of 2018'.
